verdict.rationale: Angular's first-party CLI documents scriptable commands that suit automated pipelines: build to dist/, unit tests, end-to-end tests, linting, deploy builders, Architect targets and cache configuration. However, nothing in the evidence explicitly addresses headless or CI usage. Missing for 10: explicit CI/headless documentation (non-interactive flags, headless browser test runs, CI setup guides), and independent or hands-on corroboration of Angular running in CI pipelines.
